theory.title: Exercise 4.1.3: Dictionary Operations
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Dictionaries are perfect for configuration, state tracking, API responses. Collections library gives you full control—add, update, retrieve, delete key-value pairs dynamically."

Dictionary Manipulation

Set To Dictionary - Add or update entries:

&{config}=    Create Dictionary    timeout=30
Set To Dictionary    ${config}    timeout=60    retries=3
# Now: {timeout: 60, retries: 3}

Get From Dictionary - Retrieve value by key:

${value}=    Get From Dictionary    ${config}    timeout
# Returns: 60

Other Dictionary Keywords:

  • Get Dictionary Keys: Returns list of all keys
  • Get Dictionary Values: Returns list of all values
  • Remove From Dictionary: Delete key-value pair
  • Dictionary Should Contain Key: Assertion for key existence
  • Log Dictionary: Display all contents

Example: Configuration Management

*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Update Configuration
    &{config}=    Create Dictionary    host=localhost    port=8080
    Set To Dictionary    ${config}    port=9090    ssl=True
    ${port}=    Get From Dictionary    ${config}    port
    Should Be Equal As Integers    ${port}    9090

⚠️ Dictionary Operation Tips

  • Set To Dictionary modifies original dict (in-place)
  • Can add multiple key=value pairs in one call
  • Get From Dictionary fails if key doesn't exist
  • Use Get From Dictionary with default: Get From Dictionary ${dict} key default_value
  • Keys are case-sensitive
